          ¬RH2Fid.StarP (RH2Fid.fullEn MGraph.k33) RH2Fid.cK33bad ∧ RH2Fid.TwoCutReducedP (RH2Fid.fullEn MGraph.k33)) ∧
        (RH2Fid.StarP (RH2Fid.fullEn RH2Fid.wPrism) RH2Fid.cPrism ∧

  (hct : ∀ (c : C) (s : ℕ), ct c s < k) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → W) (χ : ℕ → C),
  (∀ j < n, ∃ wk ck, (∀ p ≤ 3 * Wr.D, wk p = ω ((j + p) % n) ∧ ck p = χ ((j + p) % n)) ∧ winOK Wr ct wk ck = true) →
    MGraph.Star k (bcol q ct hct χ)
@BG_ends : ∀ {W : Type} {r q : ℕ} (Wr : Wir W r q) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → W) (J s : ℕ),
  J < n →
    s < q →
      ∃ (h : J * q + s < n * q),
        ↑((BG Wr n ω).ends ⟨J * q + s, h⟩).1 = J * r + Wr.src (ω J) s ∧
          ↑((BG Wr n ω).ends ⟨J * q + s, h⟩).2 = (J + Wr.jmp (ω J) s) % n * r + Wr.dst (ω J) s
